rules.statement: Failure to deposit security and hypothecate it by bond is fatal to the appeal and cannot be cured by invoking Section 759(2) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: The failure to comply with the requirement of Section 755 (2) is fatal to the appeal and it has been held repeatedly by this court that it cannot be cured by Section 759 (2) of Civil Procedure Code.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 759(2) of the Civil Procedure Code

meta.parties: Noordeen Lebbe v. Mohamadu Ameer and Others
